text.aria-label: Title text 'Planned contrasts in quantile score, own history, mean over six farms, 12 to 36 h, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.4% interval from resampling whole months (Bonferroni over eight contrasts). Grey rule: no change.'
